## [create permalink](https://paystack.com/docs/api/refund/\#create) Create Refund

Initiate a refund on your integration

### Headers

authorization

String

Set value to `Bearer SECRET_KEY`

content-type

String

Set value to `application/json`

### Body Parameters

transaction

String

Transaction reference or id

amount

Integer

optional

Amount, in the subunit of the [supported currency](https://paystack.com/docs/api/#supported-currency), to be refunded to the customer. Amount is optional(defaults to original transaction amount) and cannot be more than the original transaction amount.

currency

String

optional

Any of the [supported currency](https://paystack.com/docs/api/#supported-currency)

customer\_note

String

optional

Customer reason

merchant\_note

String

optional

Merchant reason

POST/refund

cURLNodePHP

cURL

Copy

```
1#!/bin/sh
2url="https://api.paystack.co/refund"
3authorization="Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY"
4content_type="Content-Type: application/json"
5data='{ "transaction": 1641 }'
6

7curl "$url" -H "$authorization" -H "$content_type" -d "$data" -X POST
```

## [retry permalink](https://paystack.com/docs/api/refund/\#retry) Retry Refund

Retry a refund with a `needs-attention` status by providing the bank account details of a customer.

### Headers

authorization

String

Set value to `Bearer SECRET_KEY`

content-type

String

Set value to `application/json`

### Path Parameters

id

integer

The ID of the previously initiated refund

### Body Parameters

refund\_account\_details

object

An object that contains the customer’s account details for refund

Show parameters

currency

string

The currency of the customer's bank account. It should be the same as the currency the payment was made

account\_number

string

The customer's account number

bank\_id

string

The ID representing the customer's bank. You can get the list of bank IDs by calling the [List Banks](https://paystack.com/docs/api/miscellaneous#bank) endpoint.

POST/refund/retry\_with\_customer\_details/{id}

cURLNodePHP

cURL

Copy

```
1#!/bin/sh
2url="https://api.paystack.co/refund/retry_with_customer_details/{id}"
3authorization="Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY"
4content_type="Content-Type: application/json"
5data='{
6  "refund_account_details": {
7    "currency": "NGN",
8    "account_number": "1234567890",
9    "bank_id": "9"
10  }
11}'
12

13curl "$url" -H "$authorization" -H "$content_type" -d "$data" -X POST
```

## [list permalink](https://paystack.com/docs/api/refund/\#list) List Refunds

List refunds available on your integration

### Headers

authorization

String

Set value to `Bearer SECRET_KEY`

### Query Parameters

transaction

String

The transaction ID of the refunded transaction

currency

String

Any of the [supported currency](https://paystack.com/docs/api/#supported-currency)

from

Date

optional

A timestamp from which to start listing refund e.g. `2016-09-21`

to

Date

optional

A timestamp at which to stop listing refund e.g. `2016-09-21`

perPage

Integer

optional

Specify how many records you want to retrieve per page. If not specified we use a default value of 50.

page

Integer

optional

Specify exactly what refund you want to page. If not specified we use a default value of 1.

GET/refund

cURLNodePHP

cURL

Copy

```
1#!/bin/sh
2url="https://api.paystack.co/refund"
3authorization="Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SECRET_KEY"
4

5curl "$url" -H "$authorization" -X GET
```
